This study was performed to evaluate the efficacy of the current readiness guidelines based on the epidemiology of encountered HMCIs.

METHODS: A retrospective study of HMCIs was recorded in the Israeli Defense Force (IDF) home front command and the Israeli National Trauma Registry (ITR) between November 2000 and June 2003.
